dz: 在汉尼拔的伏击下一支迦太基人部队,并击败了由盖乌斯·弗拉米尼乌斯所指挥的罗马军队,在第二次普尼克战争期间的特拉西门内湖战役中被击败.
de: A Carthaginian force under Hannibal ambushes and defeats a Roman army commanded by Gaius Flaminius in the battle of lake Trasimene during the Second Punic War.

t: 埃及的托勒密四世腓力活佛击败了塞琉西德王国大帝安提俄克三世.
te: Ptolemy IV Philopator of Egypt defeats Antiochus III the Great of the Seleucid kingdom.
dz: 拉菲亚之战:埃及的托勒密四世腓力活佛击败了塞琉西德王国大帝安提俄克三世.
de: Battle of Raphia: Ptolemy IV Philopator of Egypt defeats Antiochus III the Great of the Seleucid kingdom.
